name: Nemuel
overview: The name Nemuel appears in Scripture as belonging to two distinct individuals from different tribes of Israel. One Nemuel is identified as a Reubenite, mentioned alongside Dathan and Abiram, who are noted for their rebellion against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah. The other Nemuel is a son of Simeon, serving as the patriarch of the family of the Nemuelites, highlighting the tribal genealogies that God established among His people. These references underscore the importance of lineage and the contrasting legacies within Israel's history.
